criteria.name: B148-1
criteria.statement: Page titles, eligibility sentences and column headers are printed verbatim; the rate column is the one the source calls 'Initial interest rate' (D54); every row resolves LTV, period, product, rate, fee, incentive, max loan and follow-on rate, and agrees field by field with a same-day second read. Rows that fail are shelved and named; more than one in ten shelved on a page is FAIL.

criteria.name: B148-2
criteria.statement: Every snapshot carries SHA-256, a fetch time bracket, offset and the prompt; one bank's four pages are read within one hour; a second read at least 24 hours after the first is compared row by row. Missing items FAIL; second read not yet due is pending.

criteria.detail: read 10: mismatch; read {'F 60% 2y FeeSaver': '5.36', 'M 60% 2y FeeSaver': '5.29', 'F 60% 5y Standard': '5.09', 'M 60% 5y Standard': '5.06'}; mismatches ['F 60% 2y FeeSaver: read 5.31, known 5.36', 'M 60% 2y FeeSaver: read 5.19, known 5.29', 'F 60% 5y Standard: read 5.04, known 5.09', 'M 60% 5y Standard: read 4.99, known 5.06']; version []; next-day reads [('10', 134, 0)]
criteria.name: B148-3
criteria.statement: Four rates read at the gate read back: 60% 2y Fee Saver F 5.36, M 5.29; 60% 5y Standard F 5.09, M 5.06. Version mark: fixed end dates 31.01.2029 and 31.01.2032. A changed version is the third state; an unchanged version with a mismatch is FAIL.

criteria.detail: 750 incentive-neutral squares printed in the record
criteria.name: B148-4
criteria.statement: Every incentive-neutral square is printed: four cells (class, position, rate, incentive) and the square in units of 0.01 point; zero squares print the two equal differences.

criteria.detail: {"max_units": "36", "n_nonzero": 24, "n_positions": 24}; Premier as class line: passed True, grid B
criteria.name: B148-5
criteria.rival_entailment: Two classes at one position pay the same rate; where both incentives are zero and the fee is the same, r(a, j) - r(b, j) = 0.
criteria.rival_premise: The price is a scalar on the position: r(a, j) = p(j).
criteria.statement: Rival, bare scalar field: two classes at one position pay the same rate. Read where both classes have zero incentive (the fee is part of the position).

criteria.detail: {"max_units": "38", "n_ge2": 542, "n_nonzero": 624, "n_one_unit": 82, "n_squares": 750}; Premier as class line: passed True, grid B
criteria.name: B148-6
criteria.rival_premise: The price is a class potential plus a position potential: r(a, j) = alpha(a) + beta(j).
criteria.statement: Rival, additive separation r(a,j)=alpha(a)+beta(j): every incentive-neutral square is exactly zero (Fraction).

criteria.detail: {"n_crossing_groups": 3, "n_groups": 36, "n_ratio_not_one": 678, "n_ratio_not_one_and_ge2": 542, "n_squares": 750}; Premier as class line: passed True, grid B
criteria.name: B148-7
criteria.rival_entailment: (1+r(a,j))(1+r(b,k)) / ((1+r(b,j))(1+r(a,k))) = 1, and r(a,j) - r(b,j) = (A(a)-A(b)) B(j) keeps one sign across positions.
criteria.rival_premise: The gross rate is a class factor times a position price: 1 + r(a, j) = A(a) B(j).
criteria.statement: Rival, multiplicative separation 1+r(a,j)=A(a)B(j): every four-term ratio of (1+r) is exactly one, and the class difference keeps one sign inside an incentive group.
